en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front side features a black-and-white photograph of a young child sitting on a fur rug, wearing a dress and a brimmed straw hat, in an oval vignette—typical of early 20th-century studio portraiture. Embossed text in the lower left reads 'Le Moine.' The reverse side contains handwritten messages in Swedish, a 10 öre Swedish stamp featuring a lion, and is addressed to 'Fröken Elsa Vikström, Landviksgat. 8 2tr, Luleå.' The word 'SVERIGE' on the stamp indicates Sweden.
